garden-01-after-01.alt: Green lawn crossed by curved brick paths leading to a raised dining terrace beneath mature trees.
garden-01-after-01.caption: Curved paths connect the open lawn with a shaded dining terrace and layered planting.

garden-01-before-01.alt: Wide backyard view with dry grass, a mature tree, an existing brick path, and a raised wooden deck.
garden-01-before-01.caption: The original backyard had a broad dry lawn, mature canopy, and loosely connected circulation.

garden-01-before-02.alt: Narrow bare-earth side yard beside a dark blue house, with utility boxes and a mature fig tree.
garden-01-before-02.caption: A compact side-yard area before planting and circulation were resolved.

garden-01-before-03.alt: View toward a raised dining terrace framed by low white walls, an arbor, and a large mature tree.
garden-01-before-03.caption: A third supplied starting view toward the dining terrace; its project stage needs client confirmation.

garden-01-detail-01.alt: Curved planting bed beside a green lawn leading toward a dark pergola and dining deck.
garden-01-detail-01.caption: A curved border softens the lawn edge and draws the eye toward the covered deck.

garden-01-detail-02.alt: Lawn and gravel garden beside a raised deck, with metal planters and young trees along the boundary.
garden-01-detail-02.caption: Gravel, raised metal planters, and a restrained planting palette shape the garden's quieter edge.

garden-02-after-01.alt: Brick-paved courtyard with a large striped shade canopy, outdoor counter, planting, and black-and-white walls.
garden-02-after-01.caption: A warm paved court, overhead shade, and a working outdoor counter define the finished gathering space.

garden-02-before-01.alt: Large weathered concrete courtyard with scattered tables and chairs between black and white exterior walls.
garden-02-before-01.caption: The original court offered generous space but little visual structure or shelter.

garden-02-before-02.alt: Opposite view of a weathered concrete patio with loose seating, bins, potted plants, and a planted slope beyond.
garden-02-before-02.caption: The reverse angle shows the open edge and mix of storage, seating, and planting before the update.

garden-02-detail-01.alt: Sunny brick patio with dining table, relaxed lounge chairs, potted plants, and striped shade cloth overhead.
garden-02-detail-01.caption: Brick underfoot and filtered shade give the courtyard a warmer, more settled character.

garden-03-after-01.alt: Irregular stone terrace with dining and lounge areas beneath a fabric shade sail, surrounded by hedges and planting.
garden-03-after-01.caption: A broad stone terrace settles into the garden with shade, seating, and planting at its edges.

garden-03-before-01.alt: Backyard with patchy lawn, a small red deck, loose lounge furniture, and a tall hedge along one side.
garden-03-before-01.caption: The original yard combined a small deck with an open, uneven lawn and disconnected seating.

garden-03-before-02.alt: Wider view of the patchy backyard lawn, small raised deck, detached structure, and tall palms beyond.
garden-03-before-02.caption: A wider starting view reveals the yard's separate levels and scattered outdoor functions.

garden-03-before-03.alt: Terraced backyard under construction with concrete retaining walls, brick steps, and temporary furnishings.
garden-03-before-03.caption: An additional supplied view records a hardscape construction stage; its sequence needs client confirmation.

garden-03-detail-01.alt: Built-in wooden seating set into rounded river-stone retaining walls around a planted upper lawn.
garden-03-detail-01.caption: Rounded stone walls and integrated timber seating make the change in level feel useful and intentional.

garden-03-detail-02.alt: Elevated view across a shaded stone dining terrace bordered by silvery plants, succulents, and small trees.
garden-03-detail-02.caption: Layered planting frames the terrace while leaving generous room for dining and circulation.
